units.source_text: 九月初十过后，山野秋气萧索，即使不是深知情趣的人，亦必真心感动。

en.t: After the tenth day of the ninth month, the hills and fields took on a desolate autumn air, and even those with no deep feeling for such scenes could not help being moved.

units.source_text: 林木末梢的秋叶和山上的葛叶，不堪山风狂吹，慌忙纷纷散落，

en.t: The autumn leaves at the tips of the trees and the kudzu leaves on the mountains could not withstand the fierce mountain wind and scattered in a hurried flutter,

units.source_text: 其声掩盖了庄严的诵经声，只有念佛之声朗朗可闻。

en.t: and their sound drowned out the solemn chanting of sutras, so that only the clear voices reciting the Buddha's name could be heard.

units.source_text: 室内人影稀少。

en.t: There were few people to be seen indoors.

units.source_text: 群鹿被寒风吹逐，都傍着篱垣彷徨，或者躲入深黄色的稻田中，

en.t: Herds of deer, driven by the cold wind, wandered along the fences or hid in the deep yellow rice fields,

units.source_text: 不怕驱鸟器的声响，引颈长鸣，令人听了发愁。

en.t: unafraid of the clatter of the bird scarers, stretching out their necks and crying long calls that saddened anyone who heard them.

units.source_text: 瀑布之声不断轰响，更使愁人增悲。

en.t: The waterfall roared without cease, deepening the sorrow of anyone already grieving.

units.source_text: 只有草丛中的秋虫唧唧之声是微弱的。

en.t: Only the chirping of the autumn insects in the grass was faint.

units.source_text: 龙胆从枯草中突出，表示惟我独长。

en.t: Gentians thrust up from the withered grass, as if declaring that they alone still flourished.

units.source_text: 这些带露的花草，都是秋季照例应有的景色，

en.t: These dew-laden flowers and grasses were all sights that autumn naturally brings,

units.source_text: 但在此时此地看来，觉得特别凄凉难堪。

en.t: but seen here at this moment, they seemed especially bleak and unbearable.

units.source_text: 夕雾照例走近西面的边门，站着看看四周光景。

en.t: As usual, Yugiri went over to the western side gate and stood there looking around at the scene.

units.source_text: 他身穿平日穿惯的常礼服，里面的深色砑光衬衣鲜丽地露出在外面。

en.t: He wore the formal robe he was accustomed to wearing, and the dark, glossy underrobe beneath showed brightly at the edges.

units.source_text: 光线微弱的夕阳毫无顾忌地向他照射，使他觉得眩目，

en.t: The dim evening sun shone straight at him without restraint, dazzling his eyes,

units.source_text: 漫不经心地举起扇子来遮光。

en.t: and he casually raised his fan to shade himself from the light.

units.source_text: 众侍女看了，觉得这种优美的手势，应该是女子所有，女子尚且做不出来呢。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting saw this and thought that such an elegant gesture ought to belong to a woman, yet even a woman could hardly have done it so well.

units.source_text: 他装着可使愁人欣慰而微笑的和悦之相，指名宣召侍女小少将君。

en.t: Putting on a gentle expression that might comfort a sorrowful person and bring a smile, he called by name for the lady-in-waiting Koshōshō no Kimi.

units.source_text: 小少将君奉命前来，站在离开他所站的廊下极近的地方。

en.t: Koshōshō no Kimi came as summoned and stood very near the veranda where he was standing.

units.source_text: 但他深恐帘内有别的侍女，不便和她详谈，便对她说：

en.t: But he was deeply afraid that other ladies might be behind the blinds, making it awkward to speak with her at length, so he said to her:

units.source_text: “再走近些吧！不要疏远我呀！

en.t: "Come a little closer. Do not keep me at such a distance.

units.source_text: 我不辞跋涉之劳，特地来到这深山之中，这一片诚心不可忽视啊！

en.t: I have made this difficult journey all the way into these deep mountains; you must not disregard such sincerity.

units.source_text: 况且雾如此重。”

en.t: Besides, the mist is so heavy."

units.source_text: 他装作不看着她，而向山的方面眺望，又说：“再近来些，再近来些！”

en.t: Pretending not to look at her, he gazed toward the mountains and said again, "Closer, come closer."

units.source_text: 小少将君便把淡墨色的帷屏从帘端略略推开，把衣裾撩在一旁，坐了下来。

en.t: Koshōshō no Kimi then pushed the pale ink-colored curtain screen slightly aside from the edge of the blind, gathered her skirts to one side, and sat down.

units.source_text: 这小少将君是大和守的妹妹、老夫人的侄女，血缘甚近，

en.t: This Koshōshō no Kimi was the younger sister of the Governor of Yamato and the old lady's niece, so she was a close blood relative,

units.source_text: 并且从小由老夫人抚育成长，因此所穿衣服颜色甚深，

en.t: and since she had been raised by the old lady from childhood, the colors of her clothing were very dark,

units.source_text: 她身穿一套橡实色丧服，外加一件礼袍。

en.t: for she wore a full set of acorn-colored mourning clothes with a ceremonial robe over them.

units.source_text: 夕雾对她言道：“老夫人逝世，使我悲痛不尽，自不必说；

en.t: Yugiri said to her, "Needless to say, the old lady's death has left me with endless grief;

units.source_text: 加之公主一言不复，无情太甚，使我想起了心魂俱丧！

en.t: but on top of that, the princess has not answered me with a single word. Her coldness is so extreme that I feel as if I have lost both heart and soul.

units.source_text: 外人看见了我，都怪我为何如此愁苦。

en.t: When outsiders see me, they all wonder why I am so sorrowful.

units.source_text: 如今我已无法忍受了。”

en.t: Now I can no longer endure it."

units.source_text: 接着又说了许多怨恨之词，并且提起老夫人临终前寄他的信，说罢哭泣甚哀。

en.t: He then spoke many more words of resentment, and also mentioned the letter the old lady had sent him before her death; when he finished, he wept bitterly.

units.source_text: 小少将君哭得更加厉害，后来收泪答道：“那天夜晚，老夫人等候大将，岂知连回信也没有来。

en.t: Koshōshō no Kimi cried even harder, and later, holding back her tears, replied, "That night, the old lady waited for the General, but not even a reply came.

units.source_text: 其时已近临终，神思昏迷，便痛感绝望。

en.t: By then she was already near death, her mind clouded, and she felt despair most keenly.

units.source_text: 天色渐暗，病势越发沉重，那鬼怪便乘人之危，致人之命了。

en.t: As the sky grew darker and her illness worsened, that possessing spirit seized its chance and took her life.

units.source_text: 昔年卫门督逝世时，老夫人也因伤心过度，屡次昏迷过去。

en.t: In earlier years, when the Captain of the Gate Guards died, the old lady too was so overcome with grief that she fainted again and again.

units.source_text: 因见公主同样悲伤，为欲劝慰公主，勉强振作起来，渐渐恢复健康。

en.t: But seeing that the princess was grieving just as deeply, she forced herself to rally in order to comfort her, and gradually recovered her health.

units.source_text: 但此次公主遭老夫人之丧，无人劝慰，以致神志丧失，人事不省了。”

en.t: This time, however, when the princess lost the old lady, there was no one to console her, and she lost her senses and fell unconscious."

units.source_text: 她说时痛感前情，不绝悲叹，因此语言哽咽断续。

en.t: As she spoke, she felt the pain of those past events so strongly and sighed with such grief that her words came broken and choked.

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“此言诚然。

en.t: Yugiri said, "That is true.

units.source_text: 公主确已伤心过分，情绪十分委顿了。

en.t: The princess has indeed grieved too deeply, and her spirits are terribly weakened.

units.source_text: 但事已如此，恕我直言：今后公主将依靠何人呢？

en.t: But since matters have come to this, forgive me for speaking plainly: on whom will the princess rely from now on?

units.source_text: 朱雀院闭居深山之中，白云野鹤，遗世独立，通信亦甚不易。

en.t: The Suzaku Retired Emperor lives shut away deep in the mountains, apart from the world like white clouds and wild cranes, and even communication with him is very difficult.

units.source_text: 请你善为劝导，务使公主知道自身所处困境。

en.t: Please counsel her carefully, and make sure the princess understands the difficult position she is in.

units.source_text: 世间万事，都是前世制定。

en.t: Everything in this world is determined by deeds from former lives.

units.source_text: 公主虽然不欲随俗，无奈事与愿违！

en.t: Even if the princess does not wish to follow the ways of the world, things cannot always go as she desires.

units.source_text: 人生倘欲如意称心，首先须得没有死别之悲，方始可能呀！”

en.t: If a person wishes life to go entirely as the heart desires, it would first be necessary for there to be no sorrow of parting by death."

units.source_text: 他滔滔不绝地说了许多话，但小少将君一言不答，只管叹息。

en.t: He spoke on and on at great length, but Koshōshō no Kimi did not answer a word and only sighed.

units.source_text: 此时室外群鹿哀鸣。

en.t: Just then, outside the room, the herd of deer cried mournfully.

units.source_text: 夕雾听了，便吟诵“怜我独眠夜，泣声似此长”的古歌。

en.t: Hearing them, Yugiri recited an old poem: "Pity my night of sleeping alone, whose weeping voice is as long as this."

units.source_text: 接着赋诗云：

en.t: Then he composed a poem and said:
